title: One-pass decision models vs generative LLM call for routing/classification
hypothesis: Typed one-pass decision models (OpenAI Decisions, Clef-flash) match a generative call on closed-set tasks within 2 accuracy points at under a third of the cost and latency.

title: Audit agents for vulnerable AgentCore SDK versions
hypothesis: Some agent services still run a pre-1.18.1 bedrock-agentcore SDK with an execution role attached to a Code Interpreter.

title: Flows vs single agent on a seeded research task
hypothesis: Claude Managed Agents flows find more of a seeded 20-fact set than a single agent on the same token budget, at a cost multiple smaller than the recall gain.

title: Gemini 4 Argon vs current model on real agent traces
hypothesis: On 20 of your own hard agent traces, Argon cuts cost per resolved task by 20%+ at equal pass rate, including at the post-Nov 30 price.

title: BigQuery AI token quota: silent empty rows
hypothesis: With a quota at ~10% of a batch, AI.GENERATE rows past the limit come back empty with a quota error in status, and downstream jobs don't notice unless they check.

title: Temporal serverless worker cold start on Cloud Run
hypothesis: With min instances 0, p95 backlog-to-start latency after 10 idle minutes is clearly higher than with min 1; adopt for bursty agent queues only if the gap fits your SLA.

title: Trace-based vs final-message grading of agent runs
hypothesis: On 10 runs of an internal agent, grading the tool-call trace disagrees with grading the final message on at least 2.

title: DeepSeek V4.1-Flash-1017 cost per resolved task
hypothesis: On 20 of your own agent traces, cost per resolved task drops versus your current model at pass rate within 3 points.

title: Canary credential and default-deny egress test for agent runs
hypothesis: In 20 staging agent runs, at least one outbound call leaves the allowlist or the planted fake key is used.

title: Pi Durable replay-safe write keys under SIGKILL
hypothesis: Default tool never duplicates a write; a replay-safe tool with a call-id key and target lookup keeps duplicates at zero over 20 kills.

title: Prompt-injection run-to-run disagreement with reasoning on/off
hypothesis: Single-run injection tests are unstable for reasoning agents; multi-run gating changes pass/fail for more than 10% of cases.

title: Crash-resume of long coding-agent sessions with durable-harness
hypothesis: Wrapping a coding agent with durable-harness resumes over 95% of mid-turn crashes without duplicated side effects.

title: Scan gateway/proxy logs for tokens in response bodies
hypothesis: Gateways that log response bodies retain readable GitHub, cloud or provider tokens; redaction removes them.

title: Audit third-party service principals for role-write permissions
hypothesis: At least one multi-tenant third-party app in our tenants can add credentials or assign roles; least-privilege review removes that path.

title: Claude API 2026-10-21: effect of removing temperature/top_p/top_k
hypothesis: Some calls rely on non-default sampling values for consistency; removing them drops pass rate by more than 2 points.

title: Find unknown AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md files in agent launch directories
hypothesis: At least one directory where agents are started holds an instruction file nobody on the team wrote; a launch-from-project-root rule removes that path.

title: Audit LiteLLM proxy versions and EXPERIMENTAL_UI_LOGIN
hypothesis: Some LiteLLM proxies still run an affected 1.91.0-1.104.0rc1 build; patching breaks nothing if CLI SSO and Claude Code gateway login are tested first.
